# DELETE /api/v1/user/actions/variables/{variablename}

Deletes a user-level variable created by current doer

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-134`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| variablename | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Invalid argument
- **404** — Variable not found
- **500** — Internal error

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |

| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.DeleteVariable | controller | Calls actions_service.DeleteVariableByName |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | actions_service.DeleteVariableByName | service | Gets variable by name; If not found: returns ErrNotExist; Deletes by ID |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Secret/variable names must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ (case insensitive) | validation | Name does not match namePattern regex |
| Secret/variable names cannot start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_ prefix | validation | Name matches forbiddenPrefixPattern |
| Secret/variable name 'CI' is reserved and cannot be used | validation | strings.EqualFold(name, "CI") |
